lines.en: ...Is that you, Abi?!
lines.zh: ……是你吗，阿比？！

lines.en: Dear brother!  Oh my stars... I cannot describe how relieved I am to see you here!
lines.zh: 哥哥！ 我的天哪……你知道能在这见到你我有多安心吗！

lines.en: You too, Abi.  I'm so proud of you - the Temple seems to have you doing some important tasks now!
lines.zh: 我也一样，阿比。 我真为你感到骄傲。看来圣殿开始给你派一些重要的任务了！

lines.en: Yes... it is very challenging, but this is what I wanted.  But... surely you were not sent here by your leaders...  Oh, Jules, what have you done?  You are always giving yourself up for others.
lines.zh: 是的……它们非常有挑战性，但这就是我想要的。 但……你肯定不是上级主官派来的吧…… 哎呀，朱尔斯，你都做了什么？ 你总是为了别人牺牲你自己。

lines.en: Yeah, yeah, I guess so.  But now I'm with you, so it can't be all that bad, right?
lines.zh: 是，是，好像是吧。 但我现在在你身边了，所以也没那么糟，对吧？

lines.en: Some day you'll live for you and no one else, Jules...
lines.zh: 朱尔斯，总有一天你要为自己而活的……

lines.en: Aw, don't worry about me.  Let's just get through this battle in one piece, Abi!
lines.zh: 好啦，别担心我啦。 咱们一块儿平平安安打赢这场仗吧，阿比！

lines.en: The time for subtle measures has passed. Tidereavers, our objective is Fort Naxos. Surround that Fortress and have no mercy.
lines.zh: 暗中行动的时期过去了。噬浪团的勇士们，我们的目标就是那座纳克索斯堡。包围堡垒，毫不留情！

lines.en: They sent Kuroda?! Hell's bells, they're not messin' around. That guy's got killing in his blood.  Protagonist, some powerful folks want your hide.
lines.zh: 他们把黑田派来了？！我的妈，他们是认真的。那家伙流淌着杀戮的血液。 Protagonist，一些有权势的人想要你的命。
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: Protagonist, we could use your knowledge here.
lines.zh: Protagonist，我们需要你的知识。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: ...The Temple needs *my* advice? I hardly think...
lines.zh: ……圣殿需要“我”的建议？我很难相信……

lines.en: The Temple is not accustomed to the open battlefield.
lines.zh: 圣殿不常在开阔地带战斗。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Okay...  well, we're outnumbered. The standard move is to secure a defensive bottleneck.  We might try to take the small forts by the river. It's slightly better than being overwhelmed here.
lines.zh: 好吧…… 嗯，敌人数量比我们多，常规做法是守住交通要道。 可以试着把河边的小堡垒拿下来，比被在这里压着打要好些。

lines.en: Right. We will follow your command, Protagonist. Donar be with us.
lines.zh: 好的。Protagonist，我们会听从你的指挥。多纳尔与我们同在。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Looks like we're right on time.  Protagonist, don't count us out just yet.
lines.zh: 看来我们来得正是时候。 Protagonist，可别算漏我们。
lines.name: 巴纳巴斯

lines.en: The Army's going to have our heads if they find out about this!  Are you sure you're okay with this, guys?!
lines.zh: 要是被正规军发现了，我们是要掉脑袋的！ 伙计们，你们确定这没问题吗？！
lines.name: 茜比尔

lines.en: I've never known Protagonist to be sinister in any way.  There's something fishy going on and Protagonist needs our help!
lines.zh: 我就没见过Protagonist有罪恶的一面。 肯定有什么阴谋，而Protagonist需要我们的帮助！

lines.en: That's very gutsy of you, Jules...
lines.zh: 你可真有勇气，朱尔斯……
lines.name: 茜比尔

lines.en: We're way past worryin' about the Army now, kiddos, we're criminals now.  But no time for belly achin'. Let's get our butts over to Protagonist's position on the double!
lines.zh: 我们早就不用担心正规军了，小崽子们，咱们现在是罪犯啦。 不过现在不是抱怨的时候。我们快马加鞭援助Protagonist吧！
lines.name: 巴纳巴斯

lines.en: I will not throw away my life for this employer, for this mission...
lines.zh: 我可不会为了这个雇主、这项任务卖命……
